Best in Slot Gear for Restoration Shaman

rows: Your most important slot is a weapon, but this season you are guaranteed to get a very strong weapon by week 4 at the latest due to your bonus rolls on Ula'tek. Crafting a weapon that you know you will replace in the first month of the season would be a waste of myth crests, so unless you really need to secure some extra power very early on your best choice is a shield.

Your second craft is a bit less valuable than the first due to other slots being less relevant than your weapon. You still want a second embellishment but the specific timing of when you craft it can vary depending on how lucky you get with your bonus rolls.
